Name: Ivycrowned's So Many Horses (Barn Animals)
Author: NoraCharles
Description:
Since Ivycrowned is no longer maintaining [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5178]BFAV So Many Horses[/url] and has given permission for updates/modifications, I've updated it for Stardew 1.6! [b]It no longer requires BFAV, JA, or PFM[/b] -- the only required mod is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

[b]If you are interested in providing a translation, [/b]please translate the i18n/default.json file and send it to me (using a site like [url=https://www.mediafire.com/]MediaFire[/url] or [url=https://pastebin.com/]Pastebin[/url]). I will include it in the mod with credit.

Translations are already included for [b]Chinese, French, and Portuguese.[/b]


[b]FEATURES[/b]

This mod adds 2 types of horses as barn animals. Each type is available in a variety of colors, and includes adult & baby sprites for mares & foals.

[b]Draft Horses[/b]
[list]
[*]Purchase from Marnie for 8,000g each
[*]Requires a Big or Deluxe Barn
[*]Produces every day
[*]Basic produce: [b]Horse Manure[/b] (place in the Recycling Machine to produce 3-7 Quality Fertilizer) or [b]Horseshoes[/b] (place in the Recycling Machine to produce 3-7 Iron Ore)
[*]Deluxe produce: [b]Horsehair[/b] (place in the Loom to produce Cloth)
[/list][b]Sport Horses[/b]
[list]
[*]Purchase from Marnie for 16,000g each
[*]Requires a Deluxe Barn
[*]Produces every 3 days
[*]Basic produce: [b]Silver Trophy[/b] (sells for 1,000g - 2,000g depending on quality)
[*]Deluxe produce: [b]Gold Trophy[/b] (sells for 2,000g - 4,000g depending on quality)
[/list][b]
CONFIGURATION[/b]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ is highly recommended
[*]You can choose to enable Draft Horses and/or Sport Horses
[*]For Draft Horses, choose the Basic Produce type (Horse Manure or Horseshoes)
[*]For both types, choose a Default Color
[*]For both types, enable as many Skins as you like. When a new horse is purchased or born, it will be randomly assigned one of the enabled skins (or the default color). [b]If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ installed, you can buy the Scissors tool from Robin and use it to change each horse's color to any other enabled skin![/b]
[/list][b]
COMPATIBILITY[/b]

[list]
[*]Only for Stardew 1.6
[*]Should be compatible with everything! It adds custom farm animal types instead of replacing vanilla animals, and it won't conflict with other custom animal mods.
[/list][b]
CREDITS
[/b]
[b]All content (art & text) was created by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ivycrowned/about-me]Ivycrowned[/url]![/b] I've tried to keep the mod as close as possible to the original, but I did make very slight changes to some sprites to improve the horses' left/right walking animation.

Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TIANWANGDUNMOGU/about-me]TIANWANGDUNMOGU[/url] for the Chinese translation!
Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/pontassnape/about-me]pontassnape[/url] for the Portuguese translation!
Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/vin163/about-me]vin163[/url] for the French translation!


[b]MY OTHER MODS[/b]

Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/NoraCharles/mods?gameId=1303]my other mods for Stardew Valley[/url], which include maps, animals, crops, furniture, clothing, and more!
All donation points earned by my mods go to [url=https://www.doctorswithoutborders.org/]Doctors Without Borders[/url].
